title: Validate and preserve existing Vaporize work in small commits

operatorAttestation.quote: i agree. but we commit too. even old stuff.
operatorAttestation.contextQuote: Existing unrelated work is preserved at its owning boundary rather than left permanently dirty or mixed into a temporal-identity commit.

changeUnits.requestedBehavior: Preserve the International Law baseline implementation, tests, Bead, and generated source-gate evidence.
Preserve the package-supply PRD, CUJs, and DocC design as requirements-defined work.
Preserve Windows installed-executable discovery and its resolved dependency graph.

focusedProof: Exclude files at or above 100 MiB.
Run the focused i18n preflight tests and the relevant CUJ-01 Windows tests.
Commit each coherent slice through exact-file Savepoints.

owed: Resolve separately Beaded dependency-identity warnings without folding that graph repair into this intake.
returnReceipt.honestNote: The intake preserves existing work; it does not claim authorship of the pre-existing source, tests, documentation, or generated evidence.
